edited: Looking at spatial scan data (`scanspatial`) linked to projects (`projects.arcregistry` = `scanspatial.arcref`), which funding sources (`projects.fundflux`, treating a missing source as its own group) are bigger than average? For each funding source, work out the average ratio of bounding box Y (`boxy`) to bounding box Z (`boxz`), ignoring missing values, and how big it is. For the sources above the average size across funding sources, give one row with the average of their ratios, their combined size, and how far on average they exceed the average size. No rounding. Size is the number of linked spatial scan records per funding source.

queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux,
         AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS size
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) AS avg_size FROM g
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(g.size) AS combined_size,
       AVG(g.size - a.avg_size) AS avg_excess
FROM g, a
WHERE g.size > a.avg_size;
WITH per_source AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux,
         AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
         SUM(s.boxy) AS size
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) AS avg_size FROM per_source
)
SELECT AVG(ps.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(ps.size) AS combined_size,
       AVG(ps.size - o.avg_size) AS avg_excess
FROM per_source ps
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE ps.size > o.avg_size;
WITH grp AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') AS src,
         AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
         SUM(s.boxz) AS size
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing')
),
avg_all AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) AS avg_size FROM grp
)
SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio,
       SUM(g.size) AS total_size,
       AVG(g.size - a.avg_size) AS avg_excess
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN avg_all a
WHERE g.size > a.avg_size;
WITH per_source AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux,
         AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
         SUM(s.boxy * 1.0 / s.boxz) AS size
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(size) AS avg_size FROM per_source
)
SELECT AVG(ps.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios,
       SUM(ps.size) AS combined_size,
       AVG(ps.size - o.avg_size) AS avg_excess_over_avg_size
FROM per_source ps
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE ps.size > o.avg_size;
